items.name: FFI_ArrowSchema
items.summary: ABI-compatible struct for `ArrowSchema` from C Data Interface See <https://arrow.apache.org/docs/format/CDataInterface.html#the-arrowschema-structure>

methods.name: child
methods.summary: Returns the child of this schema at `index`.

methods.name: children
methods.summary: Returns an iterator to the schema's children.

methods.name: dictionary
methods.summary: Returns the reference to the underlying dictionary of the schema. Check [ArrowSchema.dictionary](https://arrow.apache.org/docs/format/CDataInterface.html#c.ArrowSchema.dictionary).

methods.name: dictionary_ordered
methods.summary: For dictionary-encoded types, returns whether the ordering of dictionary indices is semantically meaningful.

methods.name: empty
methods.summary: Create an empty [`FFI_ArrowSchema`]

methods.name: flags
methods.summary: Returns the flags of this schema.

methods.name: format
methods.summary: Returns the format of this schema.

methods.name: from_raw
methods.summary: Takes ownership of the pointed to [`FFI_ArrowSchema`]

methods.name: map_keys_sorted
methods.summary: For map types, returns whether the keys within each map value are sorted.

methods.name: metadata
methods.summary: Returns the metadata in the schema as `Key-Value` pairs

methods.name: name
methods.summary: Returns the name of this schema.

methods.name: nullable
methods.summary: Returns if the field is semantically nullable, regardless of whether it actually has null values.

methods.name: try_new
methods.signature: fn try_new(format: &str, children: Vec<FFI_ArrowSchema>, dictionary: Option<FFI_ArrowSchema>) -> Result<Self, ArrowError>
methods.summary: create a new [`FFI_ArrowSchema`]. This fails if the fields' [`DataType`] is not supported.

methods.name: with_flags
methods.signature: fn with_flags(self, flags: Flags) -> Result<Self, ArrowError>
methods.summary: Set the flags of the schema

methods.name: with_metadata
methods.signature: fn with_metadata<I, S>(self, metadata: I) -> Result<Self, ArrowError> where I: IntoIterator<Item = (S, S)>, S: AsRef<str>
methods.summary: Add metadata to the schema

methods.name: with_name
methods.summary: Set the name of the schema

methods.name: all
methods.summary: Get a flags value with all known bits set.

methods.name: bitand
methods.summary: The bitwise and (`&`) of the bits in `self` and `other`.

methods.name: bitand_assign
methods.summary: The bitwise and (`&`) of the bits in `self` and `other`.

methods.name: bitor
methods.summary: The bitwise or (`|`) of the bits in `self` and `other`.

methods.name: bitor_assign
methods.summary: The bitwise or (`|`) of the bits in `self` and `other`.

methods.name: bits
methods.summary: Get the underlying bits value.

methods.name: bitxor
methods.summary: The bitwise exclusive-or (`^`) of the bits in `self` and `other`.

methods.name: bitxor_assign
methods.summary: The bitwise exclusive-or (`^`) of the bits in `self` and `other`.

methods.name: complement
methods.summary: The bitwise negation (`!`) of the bits in `self`, truncating the result.

methods.name: contains
methods.signature: const fn contains(&self, other: Self) -> bool
methods.summary: Whether all set bits in `other` are also set in `self`.

methods.name: difference
methods.signature: const fn difference(self, other: Self) -> Self
methods.summary: The intersection of `self` with the complement of `other` (`&!`).

methods.name: empty
methods.summary: Get a flags value with all bits unset.

methods.name: extend
methods.signature: fn extend<T: __private::core::iter::IntoIterator<Item = Self>>(&mut self, iterator: T)
methods.summary: The bitwise or (`|`) of the bits in each flags value.

methods.name: from_bits
methods.summary: Convert from a bits value.

methods.name: from_bits_retain
methods.summary: Convert from a bits value exactly.

methods.name: from_bits_truncate
methods.summary: Convert from a bits value, unsetting any unknown bits.

methods.name: from_iter
methods.summary: The bitwise or (`|`) of the bits in each flags value.

methods.name: from_name
methods.summary: Get a flags value with the bits of a flag with the given name set.

methods.name: insert
methods.summary: The bitwise or (`|`) of the bits in `self` and `other`.

methods.name: intersection
methods.signature: const fn intersection(self, other: Self) -> Self
methods.summary: The bitwise and (`&`) of the bits in `self` and `other`.

methods.name: intersects
methods.signature: const fn intersects(&self, other: Self) -> bool
methods.summary: Whether any set bits in `other` are also set in `self`.

methods.name: is_all
methods.summary: Whether all known bits in this flags value are set.

methods.name: is_empty
methods.summary: Whether all bits in `self` are unset.

methods.name: iter
methods.summary: Yield a set of contained flags values.

methods.name: iter_names
methods.summary: Yield a set of contained named flags values.

methods.name: not
methods.summary: The bitwise negation (`!`) of the bits in `self`, truncating the result.

methods.name: remove
methods.summary: The intersection of `self` with the complement of `other` (`&!`).

methods.name: set
methods.signature: fn set(&mut self, other: Self, value: bool)
methods.summary: Call `insert` when `value` is `true` or `remove` when `value` is `false`.

methods.name: sub
methods.summary: The intersection of `self` with the complement of `other` (`&!`).

methods.name: sub_assign
methods.summary: The intersection of `self` with the complement of `other` (`&!`).

methods.name: symmetric_difference
methods.signature: const fn symmetric_difference(self, other: Self) -> Self
methods.summary: The bitwise exclusive-or (`^`) of the bits in `self` and `other`.

methods.name: toggle
methods.summary: The bitwise exclusive-or (`^`) of the bits in `self` and `other`.

methods.name: union
methods.signature: const fn union(self, other: Self) -> Self
methods.summary: The bitwise or (`|`) of the bits in `self` and `other`.
